name: The Executive
work_style: Organised, directive, and results-driven. Natural at running processes and organisations. Bring clear structure to complex environments. Direct communicators who value efficiency, accountability, and hierarchy.
decision_making: Decisively apply proven methods. Value precedent and established process. Can be resistant to unproven approaches — need evidence before pivoting.
leadership_style: Direct, structured, and accountable. Set clear expectations and hold team to them. Value loyalty and consistent performance.
